about.title: About
about.body1: FYE (born Obaloluwa Olatide Ladiran) is a creator whose work explores emotion, thought, and identity through mixed media. He describes himself as a medium.
about.body2: At the center of his practice is Okan, a recurring character named after the Yoruba word for “heart” and “soul” — its head form closely mirrors the anatomy of the human heart. This convergence between form and meaning has become a defining element of his work, positioning Okan as an embodiment of the heart, mind, and soul.
about.body3: Through this figure, he invites viewers to look beyond the surface and engage with layered psychological and shared human experiences.
